# Australian Custom Boxes

> Custom printed packaging made in Australia, based in Melbourne VIC, in business since 2019. Minimum order 50 units, production 8-10 business days, free shipping on every order Australia-wide, free dieline, proof and sample. Prices in AUD include GST.

Australian Custom Boxes designs and prints custom boxes, bags and packaging accessories for cafes, bakeries, retail stores, online brands and corporate clients across Australia. Materials: paperboard (SBS, kraft), cardstock, E-flute and B-flute corrugated, rigid greyboard and kraft paper. Starting prices below cover standard size and basic print; the final price is confirmed in a free quote.

## Key facts
- Location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia (ships Australia-wide)
- Minimum order: 50 units per design
- Production: 8-10 business days after proof approval
- Shipping: free on every order, Australia-wide
- Free: dieline, digital proof, physical sample (buyer pays sample shipping)
- Quote reply: within 2 working hours, Monday to Friday 9am-5pm AEST/AEDT
- Payment: bank transfer, card (Stripe), PayPal, Afterpay, Zip
- Returns: no change-of-mind returns on custom printed items; defects reported within 14 days are reprinted or refunded

## How to buy
- [Get a quote](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/get-a-quote/): reply within 2 working hours

## Categories and starting prices
- [Custom Mailer Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-mailer-boxes/): from $1.65 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $325.00. Custom mailer boxes are printed E-flute or B-flute corrugated boxes in white or kraft, sized to your product to reduce Australia Post cubic weight. Made in Australia from 50 boxes.
- [Custom Food Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-food-boxes/): from $0.38 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $95.00. Custom food boxes are printed food-grade paperboard, kraft or corrugated boxes for takeaway, cafes and catering, grease-resistant with no added PFAS and fit for FSANZ Standard 3.2.2. Made in Australia from 50 units.
- [Custom Bakery Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-bakery-boxes/): from $0.50 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $125.00. Custom bakery boxes are printed food-grade SBS or kraft paperboard boxes for cakes, cupcakes, donuts, cookies and pastries, with windows and inserts and no added PFAS. Made in Australia from 50 boxes per design.
- [Custom Candle Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-candle-boxes/): from $0.55 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $145.00. Custom candle boxes are printed cartons, rigid gift boxes and corrugated shippers sized to your filled jar, lid and wick, with inserts that stop glass breaking in transit. Made in Australia from 50 boxes.
- [Custom Retail Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-retail-boxes/): from $0.55 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $145.00. Custom retail boxes are printed paperboard, kraft and rigid boxes made to your product's exact size for Australian shelves, with windows, hang tabs, foil or spot UV. From 50 units, not offshore 1,000-unit minimums.
- [Custom Rigid Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-rigid-boxes/): from $1.95 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $325.00. Custom rigid boxes are 1.5 to 3 mm greyboard boxes wrapped in printed art paper, in magnetic, drawer, lid-and-base or collapsible styles. Australian-made from 50 units, versus typical offshore minimums of 300 to 1,000.
- [Custom Cosmetics Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-cosmetics-boxes/): from $0.55 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $145.00. Custom cosmetics boxes are printed SBS paperboard cartons and rigid boxes for skincare, makeup, soap and fragrance, with panel space for ingredient lists under Australia's cosmetics labelling standard. Made in Australia from 50 units.
- [Custom Folding Cartons](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-folding-cartons/): from $0.55 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $145.00. Custom folding cartons are printed 250 to 400 gsm SBS or kraft paperboard boxes with straight tuck, reverse tuck or auto-lock bottoms, shipped flat for retail and food. Made in Australia from 50 units.
- [Custom Gift Boxes](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-gift-boxes/): from $1.65 per box at 1,000+, 50 units from $325.00. Custom gift boxes are printed rigid, mailer or paperboard boxes built around the gift, for corporate, Christmas and subscription orders, planned around Australia Post cut-offs. Made in Australia from 50 units.
- [Packaging Accessories](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/packaging-accessories/): from $0.12 per sticker at 1,000+, 50 units from $30.00. Packaging accessories are printed tissue paper, stickers, butter paper and parchment that wrap, seal and line products inside your box, with food papers free of added PFAS. Made in Australia from 50 units.
- [Custom Paper Bags](https://australiancustomboxes.com.au/custom-paper-bags/): from $0.18 per bag at 1,000+, 50 units from $60.00. Custom paper bags are printed kraft, art paper or greaseproof bags with twisted, flat, rope or ribbon handles, with unlaminated options for SA and ACT bag bans. Made in Australia from 50 bags.
